decision.question: why do duplicate session lines get attributed to the WRONG page right after a nav
options: leave Router.js alone and patch each reader (rail.js) to re-derive the path some other way
fix the ordering bug once in core/Router/Router.js so every reader gets the right page
decision.why: app.navigated() (hence drawer.page()/location.pathname reads inside it) fired from inside activate(), which Router.go() calls and awaits BEFORE its own history.pushState() -- so ext/drawer/rail.js's sheet, which calls mount.nav(drawer.page(),...) from navigated(), always saw the page it just LEFT, not the one it arrived at. Moved the navigated() call to fire after pushState in go(), and right after load() in popped() (location is already correct there, from the browser's own back/forward). Proven headless: before the fix, a Session.say() right after navigating to /framework/audio/ logged path '/framework/ux/Dictate/' (stale); after, it's '/framework/audio/' (correct). This explains bug 3's own evidence -- a nav line lands right before each duplicate, each on a DIFFERENT path -- the sheet's own session-attribution was reading the wrong page at exactly that moment.

Bug 4 (the sheet closing by itself) has no code change either. The only rail.js edit (`rail.js:1170`) moves the chat's `nav()` call one tick later, and that changes which path a sentence is filed under, not whether the sheet closes. If the proof's `bug4.stayed_open` is true on the old code too, the proof never reproduced the owner's bug. Say which one it is, and fix the cause if it was never found.

Bug 3's proof does not use the setup the brief asked for. `proof.mjs:229` moves the main page with `router.go`; it never opens the ☰ drawer onto an ai2 page while the ✦ sheet stays on Dictate. It also skips the audio path (`say_sentence` → `log_prompt`, `flush` → `send_screen`), so a second composer whose box receives the same dictation by some other route can never show up in it. That is exactly the cause the brief suspected.

The `arm()` guard (`Mic.js:609-611`) is a reasonable fix for a mic stopped while a Whisper answer is still on its way. But the late words then stay in that mount's `held` and its box, unsent. The next time that mount's mic starts, they go out with whatever is said next, under the new page's path. Clearing them or sending them at once would be safer than leaving them in the box.

The evidence's duplicates are `via: "text"`, but `Session.js:68` `say()` defaults `via` to `"text"`. So that label does not prove that a typed send caused the duplicates. The report should say which call actually sent each duplicate.

The `session-smart.md` rule 1 rewrite and the `dir_log` call shape (lines 48-60 of the diff) do what the brief asked: answer first, a small source, never `list_agents`. Rule 1 is still one long paragraph; the parenthetical history ("the owner, 2026-10-01: an 8-minute silence…") could be cut to keep the prompt short.
